Secure the Facility

First-person tactical shooter. Clear all hostiles, manage ammo, and survive. Polished lighting, PBR materials, contact shadows, muzzle flash and hit feedback. Built in Three.js with a verified Sketchfab GLB workflow.

Movement
WASD + Mouse · Shift to sprint · Space to jump
Combat
Left-click fire · R to reload · Headshots deal 2×
Objective
Eliminate 10 hostiles before time or health expires
Tip
Click to lock pointer. Press ESC to pause.
If pointer lock fails, click again. Audio resumes on first interaction.
